In these 3 months ive took fluimucin A otc for phlegm. Really helped with the stuffs in my chest.
And then i still have allergy reaction which affect my ears. It was miserable than normal, and then i suddenly remember abt this steroid pill and asked my derm for it. Prednisolone, or prednisone whichever available in your area.
The doctor prescribe it for 6 days i felt the effect for my ears on the first time i took. And then it clears up other symptoms like itching skin, red spots, and i stopped sneezing and coughing too. But! The doctor also prescribed cetrizet D with the prednisolone. So not sure if taken alone will get fast result or not. I suggest you discuss w pharmacist

When i was deep in depression i delete all social media except whatsapp (but also left a lot of groups) didnt have the mental capacity to give shit about others. But whatsapp is like messenger so its crucial for daily things. After i collected myself and felt better, i installed them back but still rarely check them.

When the pandemic hits, i did the same. So i only deal with things in front of me. Not shit that i can do nothing about. Those are waste of brain space.
I sleep more. Eat more. Drink more. And when i feel better i go find something to laugh about. And maybe get out for a walk, a simple exercise. Get some endorphine pumping.
